title: Crosswalk Inventory / Volunteer Pilot Feasibility / Safety, Legal and Labor Requirements / Pedestrian Safety
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council instruct the Los Angeles Department of Transportation (LADOT), with the assistance of the Bureau of Engineering (BOE), the Bureau of Street Services (BSS), Office of Community Beautification (OCB), City Administrative Officer, City Attorney, and other relevant departments to report back within 90 days on the following: 1. Crosswalk Inventory: Report back on the number of existing marked crosswalks citywide, current inspection and repainting practices, number of outstanding 311 requests for deteriorating crosswalks, and annual repainting expenditures over the last two fiscal years. 2. Volunteer Pilot Feasibility: Report back on the options for establishing a pilot program that could accommodate the repainting of existing, City-approved crosswalks by community organizations and volunteers, including whether the program could operate under an existing City program such as Adopt-A-Median. 3. Safety, Legal, and Labor Requirements: Report back on labor agreement concerns, insurance requirements, safety obligations, traffic control options, and potential City liability. PRESENTED BY: Paty KATY YAROSLAVSKY Yourtensky Councilwoman5th District SECONDED BY: Cuusss Avenue ORIGINAL MAD OCT 2 8 2026
